patch_description: Add a second, deeper entangling sub-block directly after the existing RZ layer, fully reusing the same shared "theta" parameter (no new parameter name introduced, so total trainable parameter count stays at n_params=8 across the 8 repetitions). The added sub-block follows the recommended structure: RX→RY(theta) rotation layer, alternating XX(theta)/CZ nearest-neighbor ring, a lightweight skip-2 CZ sub-ring, antipodal CZ/CRX(theta) shortcuts, and a closing RZ(theta) layer. This roughly doubles expressivity/depth (~+10-40 depth, staying well below the 114-depth ceiling) while preserving perfect parameter economy, aiming to reduce convergence steps as seen in prior compact-block duplications.
